result.topic_en: Case rules giving the values of quantities w^0, w', Q^0 and Q' in terms of the parities and signs of A and B, apparently for the biquadratic character of a Gaussian prime (biquadratic reciprocity supplementary laws).
result.transcription:
Math 13 [-436-] 5 (1)
$w^0 = 0$ wenn $\frac12(A-1), \frac12 B$ gerade und $A +$
$\frac12(A-1)$ gerad, $\frac12 B$ ungerade und $A -$
in allen andern Fällen
$w^0 = -\mathrm{Int.}\{im - i(\frac12+\omega i)m\}$
$= -\mathrm{Int}$ [-...-] $(\frac12 i+\omega)m$

$w' = 0$ wenn $\frac12(A-1+B)$ gerade
$= 2$ wenn $\frac12(A-1+B)$ ungerade

$Q^0 = -\mathrm{Intens.}\left\{\begin{matrix}\mu\omega i\\ [-...-]\,\mu\omega\\ -\mu\omega i\\ +\mu\omega\end{matrix}\right\}$ für $A,B \left\{\begin{matrix}+\,+\\ -\,+\\ -\,-\\ +\,-\end{matrix}\right.$

$Q' = \left.\begin{matrix}\pm\\ \mp\\ -+\\ \pm\end{matrix}\right\}$ Intensor $\left\{\begin{matrix}\frac12 m-\mu\omega\\ \frac12 mi+\mu\omega i\\ \frac12 m+\mu\omega\\ \frac12 mi-\mu\omega i\end{matrix}\right\}$ Oberes Zeichen wenn $\frac12(A-1+B)$ gerad,
Unteres wenn ungerade

methods.what: Case rule for w^0 = 0 depending on parity of (A-1)/2, B/2 and sign of A
Formula for w^0 in remaining cases as negative integer part of an expression
Value of w' determined by parity of (A-1+B)/2
Q^0 as negative 'Intens' of μω times a unit depending on signs of A and B
Q' as signed 'Intensor' of expressions in m and μω, sign chosen by parity of (A-1+B)/2
